welcome.title: Welcome to Flux
welcome.subtitle: Your hormonal rhythm tracker
welcome.description: Flux helps you understand and track the natural hormonal cycles that affect your energy, mood, and performance every day.

circadian.title: Your 24-Hour Cycle
circadian.description: Testosterone follows a daily rhythm — peaking in the morning and dipping in the evening. Understanding this pattern helps you optimize your schedule for peak performance.

infradian.title: Your Monthly Rhythm
infradian.description: Beyond the daily cycle, men experience longer hormonal fluctuations spanning roughly 20-30 days. Tracking these patterns reveals why some weeks feel better than others.

quiz_wake: What time do you usually wake up?
profile_early_riser_desc: Your hormones peak early. You're built for morning productivity and evening rest.
profile_night_owl_desc: Your cycle is shifted later. Your peak performance comes mid-morning to early afternoon.
profile_balanced_desc: You follow the classic hormonal rhythm. Mornings are your power zone.
